en.muhajir-b-ali: 51. Zurarah narrated: I was seated in the presence of Abu 'Abd Allah (a.s) when he was asked
concerning the words of Allah [M.G]: Whoever brings a good deed, he shall have ten like it… [Holy Quran 6/160], 'Does it apply to those whom do not confess of this affair (of Wilayah)?’
'It is exclusively for believers,' he replied.
